# hyprbars

The titlebar plugin of floating workspaces, unchanged from
[hyprwm/hyprland-plugins](https://github.com/hyprwm/hyprland-plugins) at `2e03a09a92ba8b0adcd2840a69d84ffc2174b886`
(BSD 3-Clause, see LICENSE). A Hyprland plugin only loads into the Hyprland it was built
for, so it is kept as source: `aequalyn-hyprbars` builds it on each machine.

When a new Hyprland no longer takes this source, replace the files with upstream's newest
and the commit above with theirs. `built/` (the ISO's own build) is not in git.
